breakdown.description: Inviscid (zero viscosity) is incompatible with diffusion flame which relies on viscous/diffusive transport. The simulation must use sutherland transport, not zero viscosity.

The ground truth explicitly removes this and states that diffusion flames require viscous/diffusive transport. While the spec also mentions 'Transport model: Sutherland', the contradictory zero-viscosity line means the inconsistency was not resolved.
